blocking_findings.detail: phase_summary copies several original phase fields and root criteria into the printed snapshot without schema/type validation or projection. Arbitrary strings/objects in these positions bypass the redaction path. projection also retains arbitrary dictionary names, broad STRING_FIELDS strings, and arbitrary uppercase error literals.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Validate numeric/boolean/enum phase fields, retain only declared public field names and exact public enum/error values, and hash or reject unknown strings and names.

blocking_findings.detail: PRINT_BUDGET is checked only after selected/readback output files are written. It limits stdout, not cumulative derived file output.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Serialize bounded public projections, check cumulative output bytes before any write, and keep stdout accounting separate.

accepted_boundaries: API requests cannot automatically redirect with Authorization; the signed archive request is newly created without the API token and allows only HTTPS redirects.
Only two fixed artifact IDs with pinned size/SHA256, repository/run/source/tree metadata and original failed conclusions are accepted.

ZIP names are not used for file extraction or command execution; all members are streamed and checked against declared sizes and CRC; campaign binary and report hashes are bound to the verified files.
Duplicate JSON keys and non-finite numbers are rejected. No fresh native, performance or production qualification is claimed.
budget_scope: The 512 MiB decoded cap accounts for returned member bytes and rejects declared totals before streaming; it is not an RSS or codec-internal allocation limit.
The 10,000 member limit is checked after Python ZipFile has parsed the directory. JSON parsing and serialization memory are not proven bounded by the stream byte counters.
An exception during streaming aborts the whole run; this reader does not continue to process further archives after an uncharged throwing read.
source_evidence_scope: The current code checks fields of original source receipts against the fixed Git commit/tree. This review does not independently replay every original tracked-source byte from the artifact, and no native test was run.
